title: How to Jerk in 2021 | Dance Tutorial

method.teacher_system: The teacher introduces three essential steps for the jerk dance in 2021: the Reject, the Pin Drop, and the Swag. He breaks down each move by starting slowly, explaining foot placement and arm movements, and gradually increasing speed.
method.signature: He uses highly energetic, encouraging banter combined with humorous call-outs like 'I see you sitting down' to motivate the viewer.

practices.what: Teach the first move, the reject, breaking down the footwork and counts slowly.
Teach the second move, the pin drop, focusing on the leg tuck and knee positioning.
Teach the third move, the swag, explaining the open-and-close arm and body motion.

adaptations.difficulty: Starting with the leg up can be challenging
adaptations.adjustment: Start straight out instead, making it a thousand times easier

struggles.theme: Finding the jerk difficult or confusing despite easy instructions
Getting tired or lacking leg strength and endurance
Mixing up the jerk with the reject or shuffle

clicked.theme: Slow pace and clear breakdown finally made it click
Successfully doing the dance and seeing great results

requests.theme: Wanting a clip with music of the teacher going hard

meant.theme: Helped with depression and got them dancing again
Brought back good nostalgia and old days

method.limits: The video does not include background music during the breakdown portions, only counting and spoken guidance.
